title: 2022 Pakistan clip of a protester returning a tear gas canister, shared as Nepal
caption: Clip of a man catching a tear gas canister and throwing it back, shared on 10 September 2025 as viral in Nepal. Alt News traced it to a Gulf Today Facebook video of 25 May 2022 showing a protest in Pakistan.
page_url: {"url": "https://x.com/i/status/1965617923872923856", "label": "X post of 10 September 2025 presenting a 2022 Pakistan clip as a Nepal protest"}
location_method: Origin by Alt News: a reverse image search led to a Gulf Today Facebook video of 25 May 2022 (https://www.facebook.com/gulftoday/videos/549827946521789/) saying a Pakistani protester threw back a canister, during Tehreek-e-Insaf 'Azadi March' clashes. A ProPakistani report also covered it. Alt News adds signage in the clip: 'Total PARCO' on a fuel station, a Pakistani joint venture, and 'Royal Kulfi', a shop with stores across Lahore. The clip is therefore from Pakistan, three years earlier. Alt News does not give a street or coordinates. URL check: X oEmbed 200 on 2026-10-05.
verified_by: Alt News

title: Temple-gate festival clip shared as an attack on Pashupatinath Temple
caption: Clip of a crowd gripping and climbing the gates of Pashupatinath Temple, shared on 9 September 2025 as protesters attacking the temple. Fact-checkers traced it to a festival procession in March 2025.
page_url: {"url": "https://x.com/i/status/1965471566269198349", "label": "X post of 9 September 2025 presenting a temple-gate clip as an attack on Pashupatinath Temple"}
location_method: Chronolocation and place by BOOM, Alt News and Newschecker. BOOM and Newschecker traced keyframes by reverse-image search to a Facebook reel dated 14 July 2025 (https://www.facebook.com/reel/10043049515803499) and to a TikTok post of 31 March 2025 (https://www.tiktok.com/@/video/7487826733312249118). BOOM says the TikTok uploader confirmed he filmed it around the end of March 2025. Newschecker says the admin of the Facebook festival page confirmed it was recorded on 31 March 2025. Alt News matched attire between keyframes and the 14 July TikTok and noted a similar 2023 clip. The festival is not agreed: BOOM names the Basleshwori (Basleshwari) Jatra, Alt News and Newschecker the Naxal Bhagwati Jatra (see claim:pashupatinath-video-festival-and-date-conflict). Alt News adds that knocking on the temple gate is a ceremonial part of that festival. The viral X post is recorded by URL only; NDTV India also aired the clip, per BOOM, and its Instagram post has since been deleted. Coordinates basis: Wikipedia coordinates as recorded in location:pashupatinath-temple. URL check: X oEmbed 200 on 2026-10-05.
verified_by: BOOM; Alt News; Newschecker

title: Sikkim rally with a banner welcoming Modi shared as support for Modi in Nepal
caption: Clip of a procession in traditional dress with Indian flags and a banner welcoming the Indian prime minister, shared on 10 September 2025 as showing Nepalis supporting Narendra Modi. Digiteye India says the banner names Sikkim.
page_url: {"url": "https://x.com/i/status/1965682928542953700", "label": "X post of 10 September 2025 presenting a Sikkim rally clip as pro-Modi support in Nepal"}
location_method: Place and date by Digiteye India: the banner in the clip reads 'Sikkimese 300 Tribes Warmly Welcome Hon'ble Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi Ji. To Sikkim.
